# clj-ui

> clj-ui is a cross-target Clojure UI framework: one `.cljc` component renders to Hiccup (server-side, no JS), Replicant (ClojureScript) and Squint (Eucalypt). Design tokens are EDN and the CSS is generated by Babashka; interactive behavior ships as a small JS runtime. 46 components, 46 with full agent docs.

Component links point to per-component markdown with when to use, when not to, usage, props, keyboard, accessibility, motion, responsive and per-target notes.

## Install

Add the framework as a git dependency in `bb.edn` or `deps.edn`:

```edn
{:deps {clj-ui-framework/clj-ui-framework
        {:git/url "https://github.com/floscr/clj-ui-framework" :git/sha "<sha>"}}}
```

Generate the CSS once (tokens + every component style) and load the JS runtime for interactive components:

```clojure
(require '[ui.css.gen :as css])
(def theme-css  (css/build-css))   ; CSS string, or (css/build-css {:output "public/ui.css"})
(def runtime-js (css/build-js))    ; ui-runtime.js string
```

Dark mode: `data-theme="dark"` on `<html>` (auto via prefers-color-scheme otherwise). Accent: `data-accent` = neutral, blue, teal, green, amber, orange, red, pink.

## Rules for agents

- Prefer an existing clj-ui component over new markup; compose components, never restyle their internals.
- Read the component's markdown before using it and use only documented props. Follow its "When not to use".
- Components are `.cljc`: one call renders to Hiccup (`:clj`), Replicant (`:cljs`) and Squint. Mind the target table in each page (events, `:class` vector vs string, `:style` shape).
- Use the semantic tokens (`--bg-0/1/2`, `--fg-0/1/2`, `--accent`, `--accent-subtle`, `--danger`, `--success`, `--warning`, `--border-0`, `--border-subtle`, `--radius-control/panel/surface`, `--size-N`, `--font-*`) instead of raw colors or rem values, and check light and dark themes.
- Motion: `--duration-fast/standard/considered` with `--ease-standard`; animate transform, opacity and color only. Reduced motion is handled globally.
- Copy: sentence case, verbs with objects on buttons, no eyebrow labels, no uppercase transforms, weights 400 and 500 only.
- Interactive behavior that hiccup cannot express lives in the JS runtime (ui-runtime.js); load it once per page.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md): contributor guide, target pitfalls, theme system, how to add a component
- [components.md](components.md): index with public API per component
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): this file with every component page inlined

## Components

### Actions

- [Button](components/button.md): A single action with quiet secondary states, press feedback and a loading spinner.
- [Button group](components/button-group.md): Related actions as one segmented control: ghost or boxed, with icon items, counts and separators.
- [Command palette](components/command.md): A searchable command menu in a native dialog with groups, icons, shortcut hints, a global hotkey and Alt quick-select.
- [Context menu](components/context-menu.md): Secondary actions close to the object: a right-click (or long-press on touch) menu for any wrapped element.
- [Theme toggle](components/theme-toggle.md): A three-way segmented control for light, system and dark appearance, hydrated by the JS runtime.

### Inputs

- [Calendar](components/calendar.md): A compact month grid date picker with navigation, today and selection, plus pure date math that runs on every target.
- [Chip](components/chip.md): A small selectable pill for filters, tags and presets, with an optional color dot.
- [Color picker](components/color-picker.md): A saturation and brightness plane with hue and alpha tracks, a format switch (oklch, hex, rgb, hsl) and a CSS value field, driven by the runtime.
- [Drop zone](components/drop-zone.md): A generous target for dropping or picking files, with a full-page overlay variant and a click-to-add label.
- [Form](components/form.md): Labeled fields, inputs, textareas, checkboxes, radios, file and range inputs, joined groups and a search bar.
- [Number field](components/number-field.md): A bounded numeric input with increment and decrement steppers and scroll-wheel support.
- [Select](components/select.md): A compact choice field with a framework-drawn listbox, keyboard navigation and form support.
- [Switch](components/switch.md): A toggle for a setting that takes effect immediately.
- [Tag input](components/tag-input.md): Turns short text into removable tags with a filtered suggestion dropdown; fully controlled by the host.

### Disclosure

- [Accordion](components/accordion.md): Progressively reveal supporting content in place, using native details and summary with no JS.
- [Breadcrumb](components/breadcrumb.md): Shows where a page sits in a hierarchy; every item but the last is a link.
- [Dialog](components/dialog.md): A focused modal surface for decisions that need attention, as a native <dialog> or an overlay for reactive apps.
- [Popover](components/popover.md): A small anchored panel for contextual controls, built on the native Popover API so it works without app state.
- [Tabs](components/tabs.md): Switch between peer panels of one object, with no JS: hidden radios drive the panels.
- [Tooltip](components/tooltip.md): Short supporting text for an unfamiliar control, shown on hover and focus with pure CSS.

### Feedback

- [Alert](components/alert.md): A persistent inline message with a tone, icon and optional title that helps people recover or continue.
- [Empty state](components/empty-state.md): A centered placeholder with an optional icon for lists and views that have nothing to show yet.
- [File progress](components/file-progress.md): A bordered list of files with size, status and an optional progress bar and remove button.
- [Processing bar](components/processing-bar.md): A compact accent-bordered panel listing background jobs in progress with thumbnails, labels and spinners.
- [Progress](components/progress.md): Shows how much of a known task is complete as a filled track.
- [Skeleton](components/skeleton.md): Reserves space with a pulsing placeholder while content loads.
- [Spinner](components/spinner.md): An indeterminate loading indicator in four sizes that inherits the current text color.
- [Toast](components/toast.md): A brief floating confirmation for completed background work, shown by the JS runtime on every target.

### Data

- [Badge](components/badge.md): A small pill for status, category or a count, with an optional leading icon.
- [Calendar events](components/calendar-events.md): Event-aware calendar views: month grids with pills, a day ticker, an agenda list and day and week timelines, all from plain event maps.
- [Card](components/card.md): A bordered surface that groups related content and actions, plus a divided list variant.
- [Chat](components/chat.md): Conversation building blocks: a message log, user and assistant bubbles, a thinking indicator, a toolbar and an auto-growing composer.
- [File browser](components/file-browser.md): Grid tiles and a sortable list or table of files and folders with type icons, selection and per-item context menus.
- [Icon](components/icon.md): Inline Lucide-style SVG icons in four sizes, outlined by default with filled variants for media controls.
- [Pagination](components/pagination.md): Move through a long collection with numbered pages and previous and next links.
- [Table](components/table.md): Records in columns from a headers vector and row vectors, with striped and bordered variants.

### Layout

- [Tile grid](components/grid.md): A responsive auto-fill grid of square or masonry tiles with size presets, plus a layout toggle and size stepper for toolbars.
- [Resizable panels](components/panels.md): Panel groups whose panes trade space by dragging a separator, with collapse, keyboard resizing and persisted sizes.
- [Separator](components/separator.md): A hairline divider, horizontal or vertical, for grouping content.
- [Sidebar](components/sidebar.md): An app shell: a sticky sidebar with brand, search, grouped menus, collapsible sections, user footer and a mobile drawer, next to the main area.
- [Toolbar](components/toolbar.md): A pill-shaped container that groups icon buttons with separators, horizontal or vertical, optionally floating in a popover.

### Media

- [Camera](components/camera.md): A viewfinder with capture and camera switch, falling back to the native file input capture on plain HTTP, plus stream helpers.
- [Lightbox](components/lightbox.md): A fullscreen image overlay with pinch, wheel and double-tap zoom and drag to pan, plus a clickable thumbnail.
- [Player bar](components/player-bar.md): A music player bar with artwork, track info, transport controls, a scrubbable progress track and volume.
- [Editing timeline](components/timeline.md): A media editing timeline: a scrubbable ruler, labeled tracks with draggable and trimmable segments, a playhead and a floating transport.

### Text

- [Markdown](components/markdown.md): A minimal markdown to hiccup renderer for docs and chat replies: headings, code blocks, tables, lists, inline code and bold.
